title: Counting Spinal Tree-Child Networks via Word Encodings and Generating Functions
summary: We study the enumeration of spinal tree-child phylogenetic networks, a rigid family of tree-child networks in which all internal vertices lie on a single root--to--leaf path. We provide two complementary combinatorial frameworks. First, we introduce a word model: unlabeled spinal networks correspond to a suitable class of restricted words with fixed multiplicities, taken modulo a simple relabeling equivalence, which yields an explicit closed enumeration.
